import sys

def solve():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    idx = 0
    n = int(data[idx]); idx += 1
    A = [int(data[idx + i]) for i in range(3)]; idx += 3
    B = [int(data[idx + i]) for i in range(3)]; idx += 3

    winCount = 0
    nonWinCount = 0

    for i in range(3):
        winCount += min(A[i], B[(i + 1) % 3])
        possibleDefeat = min(B[i], A[(i + 1) % 3])
        possibleTie = min(B[i], A[i])
        nonWinCount += min(B[i], possibleDefeat + possibleTie)

    print(f"{n - nonWinCount} {winCount}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve()
